title: Integrated Sensing & Communications in 6G
summary: An Eye Opening Technical Talk was held on ISAC on 6G by Dr.Sahan Damith liayanaarachchi. He Explained how RF convergence in reshaping radar sensing and communications systems, paving the way for seamless integration and enhanced performance.
